notes.title: Game Release! | Launch Discount -25%!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
[b]I am glad to present you my game, the game is already available on Steam!
Please leave your feedback and suggestions, this will help make the game better![/b]

[u]Before buying[/u]
If you want to get a fully working version of the game without possible bugs, then I recommend waiting for the full release of the game and refrain from buying, but if you want to support a new project and try the game at the beginning of its development - then welcome!

notes.title: Devblog #3 | Release Soon
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

First of all, I want to thank you for your interest in the game.
A new update has been released for the game, which you can try in the demo version of the game

Included in the update:
[list]
[*] Swimming system
[*] Change in weapon recoil
[*] New weapon - grenade launcher
[*] Photo mode
[*] Some changes in driving
[*] More new items
[*] More new animation
[*] Changing and adding sounds
[*] The weapon description displays the required type of ammo
[/list]

New screenshots
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961732/0572253009b4882fabf287d45b6a5f00ffe408ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961732/2fd8be0b619962453d50d7cc577e90a4e9c24727.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961732/94b399de2200751fa5bf4f47e46efbb638f70b54.jpg[/img]

I will be glad to receive feedback and suggestions for the game, which you can leave on the Steam forum or in the [url=https://discord.gg/8Vjvx7pE]Discord channel[/url].
Game release is planned for February 2025, stay tuned, the exact date will be announced soon!
